```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
```

Follows `mcda/MCDA_paper_results_spec.md`. Instruction: `mcda/instructions/2026_11_25_industrial_streetview_gpp_sensitivity.md`,
Parts A and B. Reads the current scores (after the K3 traffic switch, the water constraint and the majority rule of
25 November 2026). **No score file is changed here**; the service road version of street greenery exists in memory only.

```{r libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(terra)
library(exactextractr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
source(here::here("R/theme_lancet.R"))
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

OUT_DIR <- here::here("output/figures_mcda/checks_industrial_streetview_2026_11_25")
SV_DIR  <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "streetview_panels")
dir.create(SV_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(here::here("mcda/output"), showWarnings = FALSE)
CANOPY_DIR <- here::here("data/malta/canopy_meta")
SEED <- 20261125
INDUSTRIAL <- "12100"
# Street classes kept for street greenery (spec 3.6; as street_greenery_canopy_malta.Rmd, Step 3a)
STREET_CLASSES <- c("primary", "secondary", "tertiary", "residential", "unclassified", "living_street",
                    "pedestrian", "trunk", paste0(c("primary", "secondary", "tertiary", "trunk"), "_link"))
knitting <- function() isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))
ktab <- function(x, caption, digits = 1) {
  x <- x %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(., digits)))
  readr::write_csv(x, file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", sub("\\..*$", "", caption)), ".csv")))
  if (!knitting()) { cat("\n", caption, "\n", sep = ""); print(as.data.frame(x), row.names = FALSE); return(invisible(x)) }
  x %>% kable(caption = caption) %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
}
top_q <- function(p) { q <- rep(NA_integer_, length(p)); q[!is.na(p)] <- ntile(p[!is.na(p)], 5); q }
```

# Inputs

```{r inputs}
malta <- readRDS(here::here("data/malta/malta_mcda_processed_realloc.rds"))
klag  <- readRDS(here::here("data/klagenfurt/klagenfurt_mcda_priority_may.rds"))
stopifnot(nrow(malta) == 10657, n_distinct(malta$gid) == 10657, nrow(klag) == 12418, n_distinct(klag$ID) == 12418)
CRS_M <- st_crs(malta)
score_files <- here::here(c("data/malta/malta_mcda_processed_realloc.rds", "data/klagenfurt/klagenfurt_mcda_priority_may.rds"))
ktab(tibble(file = sub(paste0(here::here(), "/"), "", score_files), md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(score_files)),
            modified = format(file.mtime(score_files), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")), "Score files read")

hw_m <- st_read(here::here("data/malta/accessibility_malta/own_routing/osm_highways_raw.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE) %>% st_transform(CRS_M)
hw_k <- st_read(here::here("data/klagenfurt/accessibility_klagenfurt/own_routing/osm_highways_raw.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE) %>% st_transform(st_crs(klag))
border_m <- st_sf(geometry = readRDS(here::here("data/malta/malta_union_boundary.rds")), crs = 3035)
border_k <- readRDS(here::here("data/klagenfurt/klagenfurt_boundary.rds")) %>% st_transform(3035) %>% st_union() %>% st_sf(geometry = .)
councils <- st_read(here::here("data/malta/Population_Malta_Districts.geojson"), quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(3035) %>% group_by(NAME) %>% summarise(.groups = "drop") %>% st_intersection(st_union(border_m))
tiles <- readLines(file.path(CANOPY_DIR, "tiles_malta.txt"))
r_all <- vrt(file.path(CANOPY_DIR, paste0("chm_", tiles, ".tif")))
```

# Part A. Industrial cells

Industrial cell = majority Urban Atlas class 12100 (Industrial, commercial, public, military and private units),
with the majority rule of spec 1.3 (class with the largest total area in the cell): Malta Urban Atlas 2021
(`ua_code_2021`), Klagenfurt Urban Atlas 2018 (`ua_code_2018`, as for water). Service roads = OSM
`highway = service` (roads inside estates, car parks, driveways). A road is "inside" a cell if at least 1 m of
it lies in the cell. Klagenfurt has no street greenery criterion, so its street counts are for information only.

## A1. Counts

```{r A1-counts}
road_len <- function(cells, id, roads) {
  if (nrow(roads) == 0 || nrow(cells) == 0) return(tibble(!!id := cells[[id]], len_m = 0))
  x <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(cells %>% select(all_of(id)), roads %>% select(highway)))
  x <- x %>% mutate(len_m = as.numeric(st_length(.))) %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% group_by(.data[[id]]) %>%
    summarise(len_m = sum(len_m), .groups = "drop")
  cells %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(id)) %>% left_join(x, by = id) %>% mutate(len_m = coalesce(len_m, 0))
}
ind_m <- malta %>% filter(ua_code_2021 == INDUSTRIAL)
ind_k <- klag %>% filter(!is.na(ua_code_2018), ua_code_2018 == INDUSTRIAL)
ind_m <- ind_m %>%
  mutate(kept_street_m = road_len(ind_m, "gid", hw_m %>% filter(highway %in% STREET_CLASSES))$len_m,
         service_m     = road_len(ind_m, "gid", hw_m %>% filter(highway == "service"))$len_m,
         no_street_buffer = is.na(street_canopy_pct))
ind_k <- ind_k %>%
  mutate(kept_street_m = road_len(ind_k, "ID", hw_k %>% filter(highway %in% STREET_CLASSES))$len_m,
         service_m     = road_len(ind_k, "ID", hw_k %>% filter(highway == "service"))$len_m)

A1 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(city = "Malta", industrial_cells = nrow(ind_m), scored = sum(ind_m$scored),
         no_kept_street = sum(ind_m$no_street_buffer & ind_m$scored),
         no_kept_street_with_service_roads = sum(ind_m$no_street_buffer & ind_m$scored & ind_m$service_m >= 1),
         population = sum(ind_m$Total_Population, na.rm = TRUE),
         population_no_kept_street = sum(ind_m$Total_Population[ind_m$no_street_buffer & ind_m$scored], na.rm = TRUE)),
  tibble(city = "Klagenfurt", industrial_cells = nrow(ind_k), scored = sum(ind_k$scored),
         no_kept_street = sum(ind_k$kept_street_m < 1 & ind_k$scored),
         no_kept_street_with_service_roads = sum(ind_k$kept_street_m < 1 & ind_k$scored & ind_k$service_m >= 1),
         population = sum(ind_k$popdense_2020, na.rm = TRUE),
         population_no_kept_street = sum(ind_k$popdense_2020[ind_k$kept_street_m < 1 & ind_k$scored], na.rm = TRUE)))
ktab(A1, "A1. Industrial cells (majority class 12100). Malta: no kept street = no street buffer, street greenery not applicable (score 0). Klagenfurt: street classes counted for information only (no street greenery criterion)", 0)
```

```{r A1-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=3.5}
A1 %>% select(city, `Scored industrial cells` = scored, `No kept street` = no_kept_street,
              `No kept street, service roads inside` = no_kept_street_with_service_roads) %>%
  pivot_longer(-city) %>% mutate(name = factor(name, levels = unique(name))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(name, value, fill = city)) + geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Malta = "#2166ac", Klagenfurt = "#b2182b"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cells") + theme_lancet() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## A2. Street greenery in Malta industrial cells

Canopy (height 3 m or more) share of a 10 m buffer, as the main indicator (`street_greenery_canopy_malta.Rmd`).
For industrial cells with only service roads, the share of a 10 m buffer around those service roads is computed
here only, as information. The service road version used in A3 takes kept streets and service roads together.

```{r A2-extract}
r_m <- crop(r_all, ext(vect(st_transform(st_buffer(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(ind_m)), 100), 3857))))
canopy_share <- function(cells, roads, dist = 10) {
  b <- st_union(st_buffer(roads, dist))
  p <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(cells %>% select(gid), b)) %>% st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
    group_by(gid) %>% summarise(do_union = TRUE, .groups = "drop")
  if (nrow(p) == 0) return(tibble(gid = character(), pct = numeric()))
  e <- exact_extract(r_m, st_transform(p, 3857), fun = function(v, cf) { ok <- !is.na(v); sum(cf[ok] * (v[ok] >= 3)) / sum(cf[ok]) },
                     progress = FALSE)
  tibble(gid = p$gid, pct = 100 * e)
}
near <- function(roads) roads %>% st_filter(st_buffer(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(ind_m)), 50))
svc_only <- ind_m %>% filter(no_street_buffer, service_m >= 1)
svc_share <- canopy_share(svc_only, near(hw_m %>% filter(highway == "service"))) %>% rename(service_canopy_pct = pct)
var_share <- canopy_share(ind_m, near(hw_m %>% filter(highway %in% c(STREET_CLASSES, "service")))) %>% rename(street_canopy_pct_svc = pct)
ind_m <- ind_m %>% left_join(svc_share, by = "gid") %>% left_join(var_share, by = "gid")
# Check: where no service road lies within 10 m of the cell (so no service road buffer reaches it), the
# combined share equals the main indicator
svc_near <- lengths(st_is_within_distance(ind_m, hw_m %>% filter(highway == "service"), 10.5)) > 0
chk <- ind_m %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% filter(!svc_near, !is.na(street_canopy_pct))
cat("Check cells:", nrow(chk), "| max abs difference (percentage points):",
    signif(max(abs(chk$street_canopy_pct_svc - chk$street_canopy_pct), na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
stopifnot(max(abs(chk$street_canopy_pct_svc - chk$street_canopy_pct), na.rm = TRUE) < 0.5)

summ <- function(x, what) tibble(indicator = what, cells = sum(!is.na(x)), zero = sum(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                                 median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE), p25 = quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
                                 p75 = quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), p98 = quantile(x, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE), max = max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
sc_m <- ind_m %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% filter(scored)
all_m <- malta %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% filter(scored)
ktab(bind_rows(summ(all_m$street_canopy_pct, "All scored Malta cells: street canopy (%)"),
               summ(sc_m$street_canopy_pct, "Industrial cells: street canopy (%), where defined"),
               summ(sc_m$service_canopy_pct, "Industrial cells with only service roads: service road canopy (%), information"),
               summ(sc_m$street_canopy_pct_svc, "Industrial cells: kept streets and service roads (%), A3 version")),
     "A2. Street canopy share of the 10 m buffer (%)")
```

```{r A2-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=3.5}
bind_rows(tibble(group = "All scored cells", x = all_m$street_canopy_pct),
          tibble(group = "Industrial cells", x = sc_m$street_canopy_pct),
          tibble(group = "Industrial, service roads only (information)", x = sc_m$service_canopy_pct)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(x)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, fill = "#4E8A5E", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free_y") + labs(x = "Canopy share of the 10 m buffer (%)", y = "Cells") + theme_lancet()
```

## A3. Priority with service roads as streets in industrial cells (in memory only)

Street canopy of Malta industrial cells recomputed with kept streets and service roads; every other cell keeps
its value. Normalisation as the score (spec 3.6): 1 minus min max, 0 to the p98 over eligible cells with a value,
no street = 0. Weights and available weight rule as the main score (scored cells unchanged, street greenery is
never missing). Quintiles over all scored cells of each score.

```{r A3-variant}
vars_m <- c("norm_lst", "norm_imd", "norm_dist_bs", "norm_Lden", "norm_traffic", "norm_no2", "norm_tree",
            "norm_green_time", "norm_dist_rec", "norm_green_exp")
d <- st_drop_geometry(malta)
cc <- d[complete.cases(d[, vars_m]) & !is.na(d$priority_citizen), ]
w <- coef(lm(reformulate(vars_m, "priority_citizen", intercept = FALSE), data = cc))[vars_m]
score_avail <- function(df) {
  S <- as.matrix(df[, vars_m]); A <- !is.na(S); S[!A] <- 0
  out <- as.numeric(S %*% w) / as.numeric(A %*% w); out[!df$scored] <- NA; out
}
stopifnot(max(abs(score_avail(d) - d$priority_citizen), na.rm = TRUE) < 1e-10)

x_var <- d$street_canopy_pct
iv <- match(ind_m$gid, d$gid)
x_var[iv] <- ind_m$street_canopy_pct_svc
up_main <- quantile(d$street_canopy_pct[!d$ua_not_eligible], 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)
up_var  <- quantile(x_var[!d$ua_not_eligible], 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)
norm_var <- 1 - pmin(pmax(x_var, 0), up_var) / up_var; norm_var[is.na(norm_var)] <- 0
stopifnot(max(abs((1 - pmin(pmax(d$street_canopy_pct, 0), up_main) / up_main) %>% replace(is.na(.), 0) - d$norm_tree)) < 1e-10)
p_var <- score_avail(d %>% mutate(norm_tree = norm_var))

q_main <- top_q(d$priority_citizen); q_var <- top_q(p_var)
is_ind <- d$ua_code_2021 == INDUSTRIAL & d$scored
A3_q <- bind_rows(tibble(score = "Current", q = q_main[is_ind]), tibble(score = "Service roads as streets", q = q_var[is_ind])) %>%
  count(score, q) %>% group_by(score) %>% mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(quintile = paste0("Q", q)) %>% select(score, quintile, cells = n, pct)
ktab(A3_q %>% pivot_wider(names_from = score, values_from = c(cells, pct)),
     "A3a. Priority quintile of scored Malta industrial cells, current vs service roads as streets")
k <- !is.na(d$priority_citizen) & !is.na(p_var)
A3 <- tibble(cells_scored = sum(k), industrial_cells_scored = sum(is_ind),
             industrial_cells_value_changed = sum(abs(norm_var - d$norm_tree)[is_ind] > 1e-12),
             p98_main = up_main, p98_variant = up_var,
             spearman_all = cor(d$priority_citizen[k], p_var[k], method = "spearman"),
             top_quintile_overlap_pct = 100 * sum(q_main == 5 & q_var == 5, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(q_main == 5, na.rm = TRUE),
             industrial_changing_quintile = sum(q_main[is_ind] != q_var[is_ind]),
             spearman_industrial = cor(d$priority_citizen[is_ind], p_var[is_ind], method = "spearman"))
ktab(A3, "A3b. Current score vs service roads as streets in industrial cells (Malta)", 3)

# Klagenfurt: no street greenery criterion; quintile distribution of industrial cells only
qk <- top_q(klag$priority_citizen)
ktab(tibble(quintile = paste0("Q", 1:5), cells = tabulate(qk[!is.na(klag$ua_code_2018) & klag$ua_code_2018 == INDUSTRIAL & klag$scored], 5)) %>%
       mutate(pct = 100 * cells / sum(cells)),
     "A3c. Priority quintile of scored Klagenfurt industrial cells (current score; no street greenery criterion)")
```

```{r A3-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=3.5}
A3_q %>% ggplot(aes(quintile, pct, fill = score)) + geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Current = "grey60", `Service roads as streets` = "black"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Priority quintile", y = "Industrial cells (%)") + theme_lancet() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## A4. Map: industrial cells by quintile, service roads drawn

```{r A4-map, fig.width=11, fig.height=6.5}
quint_colours <- c("Q1 (lowest)" = "#1a9641", "Q2" = "#a6d96a", "Q3" = "#ffffbf", "Q4" = "#fdae61",
                   "Q5 (highest)" = "#d73027", "Not scored" = "grey60")
qlab <- function(q) factor(ifelse(is.na(q), "Not scored", names(quint_colours)[q]), levels = names(quint_colours))
ind_map <- function(cells, q, border, roads, tag) {
  ggplot() + geom_sf(data = border, fill = "grey95", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_sf(data = cells %>% mutate(f = qlab(q)), aes(fill = f), colour = NA) +
    geom_sf(data = roads %>% st_filter(cells), colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = quint_colours, name = "Priority quintile (industrial cells)", drop = FALSE) +
    lancet_scale_bar("bl") + labs(tag = tag) + theme_lancet_map(base_size = 8) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
p_a4 <- ind_map(ind_m, q_main[match(ind_m$gid, d$gid)], border_m, hw_m %>% filter(highway == "service"), "Malta") +
  ind_map(ind_k, qk[match(ind_k$ID, klag$ID)], border_k, hw_k %>% filter(highway == "service"), "Klagenfurt") +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_a4
save_figure_lancet(p_a4, "industrial_cells_quintile_service_roads", OUT_DIR, height_mm = 120)
```

## A5. Interactive maps: streets inside industrial cells

Zoom in to see the roads inside each estate. Layers (switch on and off at the top right): industrial cells by
priority quintile (current score), OSM service roads (orange) and kept street classes (blue, the streets that define
the street greenery buffer), over Esri World Imagery or OpenStreetMap. Click a cell for its values. Roads are clipped
to industrial cells plus 20 m. Also saved as standalone HTML in the output folder.

```{r A5-leaflet}
library(leaflet)
q_pal <- colorFactor(unname(quint_colours), levels = names(quint_colours))
leaf_city <- function(cells, q, roads, info) {
  cells <- cells %>% mutate(quintile = qlab(q)) %>% st_transform(4326)
  area <- st_union(st_buffer(st_transform(cells, 3035), 20))
  clip <- function(r) suppressWarnings(st_intersection(r %>% st_filter(area) %>% select(highway, name = any_of("name")), area)) %>%
    st_collection_extract("LINESTRING") %>% st_transform(4326)
  svc <- clip(roads %>% filter(highway == "service")); kept <- clip(roads %>% filter(highway %in% STREET_CLASSES))
  leaflet() %>%
    addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Aerial") %>%
    addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap, group = "OpenStreetMap") %>%
    addPolygons(data = cells, fillColor = ~ q_pal(quintile), fillOpacity = 0.35, color = "white", weight = 1,
                group = "Industrial cells", popup = info(cells)) %>%
    addPolylines(data = kept, color = "#2b8cbe", weight = 3, opacity = 0.9, group = "Kept streets",
                 label = ~ paste0(highway, ifelse(is.na(name), "", paste0(": ", name)))) %>%
    addPolylines(data = svc, color = "#ff7f00", weight = 3, opacity = 0.9, group = "Service roads",
                 label = ~ paste0("service", ifelse(is.na(name), "", paste0(": ", name)))) %>%
    addLegend("bottomright", pal = q_pal, values = factor(names(quint_colours), levels = names(quint_colours)),
              title = "Priority quintile", opacity = 0.7) %>%
    addLayersControl(baseGroups = c("Aerial", "OpenStreetMap"),
                     overlayGroups = c("Industrial cells", "Service roads", "Kept streets"),
                     options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE))
}
lf_m <- leaf_city(ind_m, q_main[match(ind_m$gid, d$gid)], hw_m, function(x) sprintf(
  "<b>gid %s</b>, %s<br>Quintile: %s<br>Street canopy: %s<br>No kept street: %s<br>Service roads inside: %.0f m<br>Service road canopy: %s<br>Kept streets and service roads: %s",
  x$gid, x$NAME, x$quintile, ifelse(is.na(x$street_canopy_pct), "not applicable", sprintf("%.1f%%", x$street_canopy_pct)),
  ifelse(x$no_street_buffer, "yes", "no"), x$service_m,
  ifelse(is.na(x$service_canopy_pct), "-", sprintf("%.1f%%", x$service_canopy_pct)),
  ifelse(is.na(x$street_canopy_pct_svc), "-", sprintf("%.1f%%", x$street_canopy_pct_svc))))
lf_k <- leaf_city(ind_k, qk[match(ind_k$ID, klag$ID)], hw_k, function(x) sprintf(
  "<b>ID %s</b><br>Quintile: %s<br>Kept streets inside: %.0f m<br>Service roads inside: %.0f m",
  x$ID, x$quintile, x$kept_street_m, x$service_m))
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(lf_m, file.path(OUT_DIR, "industrial_streets_malta.html"), selfcontained = TRUE)
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(lf_k, file.path(OUT_DIR, "industrial_streets_klagenfurt.html"), selfcontained = TRUE)
```

# Part B. Street View sample for street greenery (Malta)

## B1. Sample

Pool: scored Malta cells with a street buffer (`street_canopy_pct` defined). Strata: 0%; above 0% and up to the
median of cells above 0; above the 80th percentile of the pool. Ten cells per stratum at random (seed `r SEED`),
plus five Valletta cells with `street_canopy_pct` between 15 and 25% (drawn among cells of the Valletta council
not already sampled).

```{r B1-sample}
pool <- malta %>% filter(scored, !is.na(street_canopy_pct))
med_pos <- median(pool$street_canopy_pct[pool$street_canopy_pct > 0])
p80 <- quantile(pool$street_canopy_pct, 0.80)
pool <- pool %>% mutate(stratum = case_when(street_canopy_pct == 0 ~ "0%",
                                            street_canopy_pct <= med_pos ~ "Above 0 to median of cells above 0",
                                            street_canopy_pct > p80 ~ "Above p80",
                                            TRUE ~ NA_character_))
set.seed(SEED)
smp <- pool %>% filter(!is.na(stratum)) %>% group_by(stratum) %>% slice_sample(n = 10) %>% ungroup()
vall_pool <- pool %>% filter(NAME == "VALLETTA", street_canopy_pct >= 15, street_canopy_pct <= 25, !gid %in% smp$gid)
smp <- bind_rows(smp, vall_pool %>% slice_sample(n = min(5, nrow(vall_pool))) %>% mutate(stratum = "Valletta 15 to 25%"))
B1 <- pool %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% filter(!is.na(stratum)) %>% count(stratum, name = "cells_in_pool") %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(stratum = "Valletta 15 to 25%", cells_in_pool = nrow(vall_pool))) %>%
  left_join(smp %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% group_by(stratum) %>%
              summarise(sampled = n(), min_pct = min(street_canopy_pct), max_pct = max(street_canopy_pct)), by = "stratum")
ktab(bind_rows(B1, tibble(stratum = paste0("Pool: ", nrow(pool), " cells; median of cells above 0 = ", round(med_pos, 1),
                                           "%; p80 = ", round(p80, 1), "%"))),
     "B1. Street View sample: strata, pool and sampled cells")
```

```{r B1-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=3.5}
ggplot(pool, aes(street_canopy_pct)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "grey75") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(med_pos, p80), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_rug(data = smp, aes(colour = stratum), linewidth = 0.8, length = unit(4, "mm")) +
  labs(x = "Street canopy share of the 10 m buffer (%)", y = "Cells", colour = "Sampled cells") +
  theme_lancet() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## B2. Image panels

Left: canopy of 3 m or more (1 m Meta and WRI canopy height, green) over Esri World Imagery, with the 10 m street
buffer (yellow) and the cell (white). Right: locator. One PNG per cell in
`output/figures_mcda/checks_industrial_streetview_2026_11_25/streetview_panels/` and one combined PDF.

```{r B2-panels}
streets_m <- hw_m %>% filter(highway %in% STREET_CLASSES)
smp <- smp %>% mutate(order = row_number())
panel_cell <- function(i) {
  cell <- smp[i, ]
  box <- st_buffer(st_centroid(st_geometry(cell)), 110, endCapStyle = "SQUARE")
  box_w <- st_transform(box, 3857)
  sat <- tryCatch(maptiles::get_tiles(box_w, provider = "Esri.WorldImagery", zoom = 18, crop = TRUE,
                                      cachedir = file.path(CANOPY_DIR, "tiles_cache")), error = function(e) NULL)
  msk <- crop(r_all, ext(vect(box_w))) >= 3
  msk <- classify(msk, cbind(0, NA))
  buf <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(st_union(st_buffer(streets_m %>% st_filter(st_buffer(box, 30)), 10)), box))
  left <- ggplot()
  if (!is.null(sat)) left <- left + tidyterra::geom_spatraster_rgb(data = sat)
  left <- left + tidyterra::geom_spatraster(data = msk, alpha = 0.55) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#39FF14", high = "#39FF14", na.value = NA, guide = "none") +
    (if (length(buf)) geom_sf(data = st_transform(st_sf(geometry = buf), 3857), fill = NA, colour = "#FFD700", linewidth = 0.4)) +
    geom_sf(data = st_transform(cell, 3857), fill = NA, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
    coord_sf(crs = 3857, expand = FALSE, datum = NA) + theme_void()
  loc <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data = councils, fill = "grey92", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.1) +
    geom_sf(data = st_centroid(cell), colour = "#d73027", size = 2) + theme_void()
  ttl <- sprintf("gid %s, %s: street canopy %.1f%% (%s)", cell$gid, tools::toTitleCase(tolower(cell$NAME)),
                 cell$street_canopy_pct, cell$stratum)
  (left + loc + plot_layout(widths = c(2.2, 1))) +
    plot_annotation(title = ttl, caption = if (is.null(sat)) "Imagery not available" else "Imagery: Esri World Imagery",
                    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10)))
}
pdf(file.path(SV_DIR, "streetview_panels_all.pdf"), width = 9, height = 5)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(smp))) {
  p <- panel_cell(i)
  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(SV_DIR, sprintf("%02d_gid_%s.png", i, smp$gid[i])), p, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
}
invisible(dev.off())
cat("Panels written:", nrow(smp), "\n")
panel_cell(1)
```

## B3. CSV for the Street View check

```{r B3-csv}
ll <- st_coordinates(st_transform(st_centroid(st_geometry(smp)), 4326))
sv <- smp %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(order, gid, council = NAME, stratum, street_canopy_pct = round(street_canopy_pct, 1),
            latitude = round(ll[, 2], 6), longitude = round(ll[, 1], 6),
            streetview_url = sprintf("https://www.google.com/maps/@?api=1&map_action=pano&viewpoint=%.6f,%.6f", latitude, longitude),
            trees_visible = "", agrees_with_indicator = "", note = "")
readr::write_csv(sv, here::here("mcda/output/streetview_sample.csv"), na = "")
ktab(sv %>% select(order, gid, council, stratum, street_canopy_pct, latitude, longitude),
     "B3. Street View sample (mcda/output/streetview_sample.csv)", 6)
```

B4: the CSV is for manual review; agreement by stratum is summarised once it is filled.
